class.name: DisStopFreezePdu
class.brief_description: Stop/Freeze PDU (type 14): asks applications to stop or freeze the exercise.
class.description: A Stop/Freeze PDU asks the receiver to stop or freeze at the real-world time given by [member real_world_time_hour] and [member real_world_time_past_hour], for the given [member reason]. [member frozen_behavior] says what the receiver keeps doing while frozen. It is 40 bytes long. The receiver answers with a [DisAcknowledgePdu] carrying the same [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id]. The real-world time is a DIS Clock Time record: a signed 32-bit hour count and a DIS timestamp past the hour (2^31 units per hour, shifted left by one; lowest bit set = absolute time). [method get_real_world_time] and [method set_real_world_time] convert it to and from seconds.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Stop/Freeze PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Stop/Freeze PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 40 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].

method.name: get_real_world_time
method.description: Returns the real-world stop time in seconds since the UNIX epoch (UTC), computed from [member real_world_time_hour] and [member real_world_time_past_hour]. 0 means "now" for [DisExerciseControl].

method.name: set_real_world_time
method.description: Sets [member real_world_time_hour] and [member real_world_time_past_hour] from [param unix_seconds], seconds since the UNIX epoch (UTC), marking the time as absolute.

members.member: What the receiver keeps doing while frozen, as a bit mask of [enum FrozenBehavior] values (8-bit). 0 means stop completely.
The 16-bit padding field after the frozen behavior. Normally 0; kept so that decoded PDUs encode to the same bytes.
Hour part of the real-world time (signed 32-bit). See also [member real_world_time_past_hour].
Time past the hour of the real-world time as a DIS timestamp (2^31 units per hour, shifted left by one; lowest bit set = absolute).
Why the exercise is stopped or frozen (8-bit): one of the [enum Reason] values or another SISO-REF-010 "Stop/Freeze Reason" code.

constants.constant: Reason 1: the exercise is paused for a recess.
Reason 3: stopped because of a system failure.
Reason 4: stopped because of a security violation.
Reason 6: stopped so the exercise can be reset.
Reason 7: stopped so the exercise can be restarted.
Reason 8: training aborted, return to tactical operations.
Bit 1 of [member frozen_behavior]: the simulation clock keeps running while frozen.
Bit 2 of [member frozen_behavior]: the application keeps transmitting PDUs (such as Entity State updates) while frozen.
Bit 4 of [member frozen_behavior]: the application keeps processing received PDUs while frozen.
